construction: 93 parts in 7 steps. Step 1: four 1×2–1×2 brackets. Step 3: sixteen brackets along both long edges, studs out. Step 6: twelve 2×4 and four 2×1 curved-top bricks laid on their sides form the rounded long edges, with plates and tiles.
lesson: Rounded vehicle body edges from curved-top bricks laid on their sides on brackets.
reuse_notes: Use it for any long rounded body edge: buses, trains or vans.
